LESSON: WRITING 14.4.1 GUIDED WRITING

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.4: Writing 14.4.1 Guided writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 14.4.1 Guided writing, part of Strand 14 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three General.

Key inquiry question: How do we plan before writing a composition?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 14.4.1 Guided writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication: The learner’s ability to write clearly and legibly is developed as they write short narratives following the five steps of the writing

process.

● Creativity and Imagination: The learner’s originality skills are enhanced as they come up with unique and new ideas and use them to write a narrative.

Values:
Responsibility: as learner develops organisation skills in preparation for independent writing.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life-skills effective communication): as learner improves his or her communication through writing.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Guided writing skills are also emphasized in all learning areas.
